exclude.description: Glob patterns for feature files to exclude

fail-fast.description: Fail immediately on first file with problems

include.description: Glob patterns for feature files to include

record.description: Add unknown steps to the config file

steps.description: Ordered list of step patterns, can be individual regex or array of regex that should be sorted together

unknown-steps.description: steps that exist in .feature files but have an unknown order

StepPattern.description: A step pattern can be either a single regex string or a group of regex strings that can appear in any order

anyOf.description: A group of steps that get sorted maintaining their existing order relative to each other
